messages:
Evelyn (People Ops): Adrienne's candidate, K. Zhou (Senior Backend), confirmed onsite for Thu Jul 8. He noted he uses a motorized wheelchair and prefers ground-floor entry. Also asked whether we can provide a Windows VM image for his coding exercise. Can the team confirm arrangements?

Adrienne (Hiring Manager): Thu afternoon works for our panel. Prefer 13:00 start to keep travel same-day. We'll need a 90m coding + 45m design loop.

Marco (Interviewer): I can do 13:00-15:00. I'll be on campushappy to proctor the coding exercise in-person.

Sam (Scheduler): Candidate availability: Thu 12-17 local. Preference 13:00. Requested quiet workspace and wired ethernet. Also asked about reimbursement for taxi; he'll be arriving at 11:30.

Ruth (Office Admin): I'll reserve Ground Room 1 (street-level) and mark the accessible entrance. I can set up a PC with a Windows VM (clean image + VS Code) and wired ethernet. Loaner external keyboard & mouse available. Do we need a specific test repo access?

Adrienne (Hiring Manager): We'll use the private test repo 'backend-interview-2026'. Sam, add repo access for candidate and Marco. Also please include the coding prompt in the invite so candidate can prep but not pre-run.

Evelyn (People Ops): Approved taxi reimbursement up to $50. Ruth, please confirm whether we issue a voucher or reimburse on submission of receipt. Also, candidate asked about signing a brief onsite NDA. Legal approves standard one-sheeter. Who will have him sign it?

Ruth (Office Admin): We can have reception hand the NDA to candidate on arrival for signature; I'll coordinate escort. Voucher: I'll pre-authorize a taxi voucher and DM pickup code to candidate.

Sam (Scheduler): Draft schedule:
13:00-14:30 Coding (Ground Room 1 / VM)
14:30-15:15 System design (Zoom + onsite)
15:15-15:45 Panel debrief
Notes: 20m tech-check 12:40-13:00. Wired ethernet + Windows VM + loaner keyboard. Taxi voucher issued. Vegetarian snack on request.

Marco (Interviewer): I'll bring a spare HDMI monitor in case candidate prefers two displays. I'll also run the tech check remotely at 12:45 to ensure VM access.

Adrienne (Hiring Manager): Please ensure candidate badge says 'visitor - interview' and that the accessible route is highlighted. Thanks. Sam, send invites once reception confirms escort.

Evelyn (People Ops): I'll upload the NDA to the candidate folder and add signing instructions. Closing loop: Sam to send invites; Ruth to confirm room + VM; Marco to run tech-check. Ping if any blockers.
